parts.name: sole_dep_to_ong
sources: The sole: EVA, 25 mm at the heel and 16 mm at the ball (by eye from the photos); 240 kg/m3 (Footwear Science). The first dép tổ ong were of natural rubber (Tiền Phong, Hải Phòng, the 1980s: Saigoneer, 2018); the ones of today are EVA (listings of sellers).

parts.name: vamp_dep_to_ong
sources: The vamp: one piece of EVA with the sole, a lattice of rods of 5 mm with holes between them (the honeycomb of the photos, as diamonds), from 45% to 86% of the length of the foot, 59 mm over the ground at most; by eye.
